edges.reason: msg.sender triggers depositETH with ETH value
msg.sender is the depositor in deposit
msg.sender is the recipient of the low-level ETH transfer in withdrawETH
msg.sender receives the asset in withdraw
sellOptions requires order.sender.wallet to be the vault but is invoked by the manager
setManager onlyOwner compares owner() to msg.sender
setWithdrawalFee onlyManager compares msg.sender to manager
setNextOption derives nextOptionReadyAt from block.timestamp
rollToNextOption gating depends on block.timestamp versus nextOptionReadyAt
adapter address supplies the option address used by setNextOption
adapter is used for create/close short in rollToNextOption
adapter is used to close the short in emergencyWithdrawFromShort
SWAP_CONTRACT immutable is the target of the swap in sellOptions
deposit forwards amount into _deposit
depositETH forwards msg.value into _deposit
_deposit mints shares updating total supply
withdraw calls _withdraw to burn shares and compute amount
withdrawETH calls _withdraw to burn shares and compute amount
_withdraw return value feeds the ETH transfer amount in withdrawETH
withdrawETH performs the low-level ETH transfer to msg.sender
depositETH calls IWETH.deposit wrapping msg.value
withdrawETH calls IWETH.withdraw to unwrap
deposit performs safeTransferFrom of the asset
withdraw performs safeTransfer of the asset to the caller
rollToNextOption calls adapter.delegateCloseShort
rollToNextOption calls adapter.delegateCreateShort
setNextOption calls adapter.getOptionsAddress
sellOptions calls SWAP_CONTRACT.swap
emergencyWithdrawFromShort calls adapter.delegateCloseShort
external ETH transfer hands control back to msg.sender which can reenter
external swap contract returns control to sellOptions
delegatecall returns control to rollToNextOption
delegatecall returns control to rollToNextOption
external staticcall returns control to setNextOption
amount parameter is used for share computation in _deposit
share parameter determines the burn and payout in _withdraw
optionTerms parameter drives the option lookup in setNextOption
newCap parameter updates the cap state variable
newManager parameter replaces the manager state variable
shortAmount local is derived and used inside rollToNextOption
withdrawAmount local is computed and returned by _withdraw

normalization_plan.reason: The deposit amount parameter only exists to feed the minting computation in _deposit
The share parameter only exists to drive the burn and payout logic in _withdraw
The optionTerms parameter is only consumed by the option validation flow in setNextOption
The newCap parameter is only used to overwrite the cap state variable in setCap
The newManager parameter is only used to update the manager in setManager
The shortAmount local is fully local to the rollToNextOption roll logic
The withdrawAmount local is fully local to the _withdraw payout computation
